summary: Release lineage for POOL's published Rain + Monad Testnet proof. This manifest is provenance disclosure, not a signature, attestation, or independent audit.

lineage.note: These three commits are distinct facts and must never be collapsed into one claim. The historical proof predates the later product runtime.

proofSource.subject: feat(agent): add buyer decision receipts
proofSource.role: The source commit the published Rain + Monad evidence record was generated from.

productRuntime.subject: feat(submission): publish verified sponsor proof
productRuntime.role: A later product runtime commit. It did not produce the proof record.

deployedDocs.subject: docs: record verified overnight deployment
deployedDocs.role: The previously deployed commit. Superseded: the live deployment now serves 712328b, recorded under `deployment` above.

providerExecution.note: Provider actions require a server-minted demo session; they fail closed for every anonymous visitor.

deployment.note: Records the deployment that was live when this manifest was written. Because the manifest is itself served by a deployment, a later release that publishes this file will be served from a newer deployment than the one named here -- that is expected, not a mismatch. Deployed explicitly from the Vercel CLI; a push to origin does not move these aliases on its own. The deployed commit 712328b is newer than every commit in the lineage below, so the live runtime postdates the proof record it publishes. Vercel project and organization identifiers remain omitted.

digests.note: Computed over the files as published in this commit.

rain.note: Same-day idempotent replays of the same three sandbox settlements. No new real-money movement was created.

proves: Which source commit produced the published evidence record, and that two later commits did not.
That the named evidence and deck files hash to the recorded SHA-256 digests at this commit.
That the published record names the listed Rain sandbox settlement IDs and finalized Monad Testnet transactions.
Which Vercel deployment was live when this manifest was written, and which commit it was built from.
doesNotProve: real-money custody, deposits, escrow, or production payment processing
that the recorded aliases still serve this deployment, since any later deploy or alias change supersedes this record
merchant traction, buyer identity, inventory, fulfillment, returns, or a production order
that Monad independently verified Rain or the simulated buyer ledger
that this manifest was signed, notarized, or independently audited
redactions: card identifiers and card last-four values
raw provider responses and session cookies
